SMART CAMPUS NAVIGATION AND FACILITY ANALYTICS - CONTRIBUTIONS (MILESTONE 1)

Member A: Abhijeeth Chouti (GitHub: ac2526)
  Owned modules:
    - Facility records (Facility.h / Facility.cpp)
    - Custom hash table (HashTable.h / HashTable.cpp)
    - Facility database and ID search (FacilityDatabase.h / FacilityDatabase.cpp)
    - Facilities file loader
  Tests: facility loading, ID search, hash collision, duplicate IDs

Member B: Hayden Goff (GitHub: haydini06-mc)
  Owned modules:
    - Campus graph (CampusGraph.h / CampusGraph.cpp): adjacency list,
      add building and connection with validation, display, counts and
      degrees, BFS reachability
    - Buildings and connections file loaders (Fileloader.cpp),
      including the shared warning and load-summary helpers
  Tests: building and connection loading, graph display, BFS (tests B1 to B17)

Member C: Derick Ohonbamu (GitHub: derickohon)
  Owned modules:
    - Department tree (DepartmentNode.h, DepartmentTree.h / DepartmentTree.cpp):
      general tree, loading, add, search, hierarchy display, preorder
    - Department menu handlers (add and search)
  Tests: department loading, tree add/search, preorder

Shared work (all members):
    - Utils (trim, case-insensitive compare, split, comment check)
    - Menu and input handling (Menu.h / Menu.cpp)
    - Main.cpp
    - compile.bat, .gitignore, README.txt
    - design_document.txt (each member wrote their own section)
    - test_results.txt (each member recorded their own tests)
    - testdata/ test folders
